name: Potter Guardrails
description: Deterministic guards: hard wall for excluded pages, docs-consult-before-build, config write guard.

excludedIds.description: Ids that must never appear in any tool call (for example a Notion page id).

docsGate.description: Require a recent docs read before building automation/config. Default true.

configWriteGuard.description: Block direct writes to openclaw.json. Default true.

auditLog.description: Where guard decisions are logged (no content, only guard/tool/action).
